statement: Some users hesitate to purchase because they lack sufficient confidence or information about the product.
reasoning: 15 observations support Product Uncertainty and 0 go against it (15 is 34.9% of relevant comments). 4 supporting comments are observed alongside postponement, abandonment, or alternative purchase (association 26.67%). That is co-occurrence, not causation.
research_gap: Public comments cannot tell us whether Product Uncertainty is the primary reason a wishlisted item fails to convert within 30 days, who it hits hardest, or whether it happens before or after saving.

statement: Some users wishlist an item on Myntra but later find the same or a similar item elsewhere and purchase it from another platform.
reasoning: Cross-Platform Comparison was tested on 43 relevant observations. 1 supported it and 0 contradicted it — not enough classified evidence to judge.
research_gap: Public UGC does not contain enough behavioral evidence to accept or reject Cross-Platform Comparison. Interviews are required if this remains a suspected conversion path.
